title: "How many people have been seen today, and where?" answers "4 people"; the inventory holds 17 person tracks
steps: In /chat, as question 7 of one conversation (03:20 UTC), ask "How many people have been seen today, and where?".
expected: A count taken from the person tracks, with locations and a caveat. For example: "17 person tracks were seen today (approximate: tracks are built from appearance, and 7 crew are aboard): USOS 10, Node 1 Unity 2, Node 3 Tranquility 2, Cupola 1, Zvezda 1, Columbus 1." The citations should be the person items. GET /api/items?kind=person returns total 17 (by last_location: USOS 10, NOD1 2, NOD3 2, CUP1 1, ZVEZDA 1, COL1 1).
actual: After 19.8 s the agent replies "Today, 4 people have been recorded as new items" and lists 4 rows (USOS ×2, NOD3 ×2). It used only recent_changes, which returns the last hour (not today) and is capped, and it counted only the new_item rows in the first page. The 9 citations include a laptop, a spacecraft, a drill and an m-bag. The answer is wrong but reads as confident and grounded.
suggested_fix: Route counting and "who / how many people" questions to search_items(kind=person, seen_after=start of the UTC day), or add a people_seen(since) tool that returns the total and the by-location counts from the API (do not count rows out of a capped list). Always add the track caveat. Cite only person items. Add an e2e test: the count must equal /api/items?kind=person total.

title: Privacy: scene summaries of private (sleep-cue) windows are stored and full-text searchable
expected: Private windows keep no descriptive text about the private scene. The summary is redacted (e.g. "Private window: not captured") or null, and private windows are excluded from /search and from search_observations.
actual: Two windows are returned: 2615840b at 03:19:43 "person is sleeping in a sleeping bag inside the Harmony Module", and 5c1d9aa4 at 03:04:43 "...camera pans down to show another person sleeping". No media leaked: the frames for 03:04:43–03:05:18 and 03:18:13–03:20:43 return 404; NOD2 sightings in those windows have frame_url null; no review exists in either window. The adjacent stored frames (03:04:13/18, 03:05:43/48, 03:06:13/18, 03:18:48, 03:19:13, 03:20:48) show the lab, Unity, the Cupola and exercise, and none shows a sleeper or a crew-quarters interior. So this is a text leak only, not P1.
suggested_fix: When the reconciler marks a window no_capture (sleep_cue / scene_summary / privacy_hold), store scene_summary as null or as a fixed redaction, and set a private flag on observation_window. Filter `WHERE NOT w.private` in /search and in the agent's search_observations. Add a test that /search?q=sleeping is empty after a private window.

title: Person items are indistinguishable: every row and title reads "person / Crew member"
expected: The appearance description is the person's visible name everywhere: "Person: blue shirt, dark hair" in the inventory Item column, the detail-page title, review subject and candidate cards, overview events and chat citations.
actual: 15–17 rows all read "person" over "Crew member" at 50% confidence. The thumbnails are 1080×608 whole scene frames shrunk to 56 px, so they don't help either. The description only appears in the detail-page metadata. The detail page title is just "person". Review candidates are "person f51af769 / Catalog: crew-member". Thumbnails comply with privacy: every person thumbnail and hero is a full scene frame (/media/frames/...), never a crop, and exemplars = 0.
suggested_fix: For kind=person use `Person: ${description}` (truncated to ~40 chars) as the display label in a shared helper (lib/format.ts), and use it in InventoryPage, ItemDetailPage (h1), ReviewPage cards, OverviewPage events and chat citations.

title: Person movement events read as one person being moved by another
expected: A person's own track event reads "Person (short hair, blue shorts, orange top) left US Orbital Segment (USOS) · 03:10 UTC", with no separate actor. If a track's actor description differs from the track's appearance, that is a data conflict and is not shown as a different person.
actual: "MOVED person 87dbd193 by person (spacesuit, dark visor) from US Orbital Segment (USOS) to an unknown location". Track 87dbd193 is "Short hair, blue shorts, orange top". The inventory Last handled column for person rows says "Moved by person (...)". The phrasing also varies: "by person wearing a blue shirt and shorts" (no parentheses) vs "by person (blue shirt, dark hair)". 6 of the 10 overview events end in "to an unknown location".
suggested_fix: In lib/format.ts, when the event's entity is kind=person, render "left <from>" / "seen in <to>" without an actor clause. In the API or perception, don't attach an actor_desc to a person's own move (or use actor_kind=self). Strip a leading "wearing" from actor_desc before wrapping it in parentheses.

title: Person duplicate reviews flood the queue and can't be decided: no box on multi-person frames, and internal reasons are shown
steps: Open /review?kind=possible_duplicate (10 of 17 open reviews are person duplicates at 03:22 UTC).
expected: The operator can tell which person each card is about: a person-region box (allowed, since it isn't a face crop) on the scene frame. The reason is readable ("More people tracked (15) than crew aboard (7)"). Merge candidates are scored by appearance, with the conflicting attributes shown.
actual: The subject is a whole frame with 3–5 crew members (e.g. the 03:22 group-meal frame) captioned "Whole frame (no box)", so a merge decision is a guess. The description shows internals: "person: grey hoodie (15 live 'person' entities would exceed the expected count of 7)". Every person candidate shows "Similarity —", match scores of 27–37% and mostly the chip "seen around the same time". The tracks themselves mix appearances: 0d53940f holds sightings "dark blue shirt, white pants", "blue shirt, tan pants", "blue shirt, orange helmet" and "blue shirt, dark hair".
suggested_fix: Store the people[] region box with each person sighting and draw it (dashed if it comes from the model). Rewrite the review reason in the API for display. Show appearance-attribute chips ("same shirt colour", "pants differ"). Consider rate-limiting person duplicate reviews (one open review per track).

title: Overview "People seen (last hour)" shows 15 "crew sightings"; the number is person tracks, and the crew is 7
expected: "Person tracks (last hour): 15. Approximate: 7 crew aboard." The hint matches what is counted.
actual: Tile "PEOPLE SEEN (LAST HOUR) 15 / crew sightings". The value is GET /items?kind=person&seen_after=now-1h total (OverviewPage.tsx l.68-70), which counts tracks, not sightings, and is twice the crew size.
suggested_fix: Relabel the tile and its hint, and add the approximate caveat (or the expected crew count from config).

title: Crop images are captioned "Whole frame: there is no box" and upscaled until blurry
expected: Caption "Cropped from the 03:06:48 frame. Click for the full frame". The crop is not upscaled past about 2× (or the full frame is shown with the crop region outlined).
actual: The 220 px crop is stretched to 640 px wide, so it's blurry, and is captioned "Whole frame: there is no box for this object. Click to enlarge." The caption comes from FrameImage.tsx l.32 whenever no bbox exists.
suggested_fix: Have FrameImage tell crop keys (/media/crops/) apart from frames (/media/frames/), and caption them differently. Cap the scale and offer the source frame.

title: Review cards show catalog slugs: "Catalog: crew-member", "Catalog: ctb-half"
expected: "Catalog: Crew member" / "Catalog: Cargo Transfer Bag (half)", as on the inventory and detail pages.
actual: The raw catalog_id is shown (ReviewPage.tsx l.172 `Catalog: ${entity.catalog_id}`). The keep-both hint also says "(catalog ctb-half)".
suggested_fix: Use entity.catalog_name, or nameOf(catalog_id), in both places.

title: The sticky review footer takes 171 px and hides the card body at 1024×768
expected: The candidates and their Merge buttons are visible together with the subject, and the footer doesn't cover the next card.
actual: The .review-footer (position: sticky; bottom: 0) is 171 px tall, about 22% of the viewport. On load only the subject image of the first card is visible, and the candidates and Merge buttons are below the fold. While scrolling, the next card's footer pins over its own body. The footer has no merge action, so it uses that space for secondary actions.
suggested_fix: Make the footer static for duplicate cards, or collapse it to one row (Classify / Keep both / Dismiss…) with the catalog search behind a disclosure.

title: Chat change lists use machine phrasing and a different time and location format from the app
steps: Ask "What changed in the last hour?" in the conversation, and once as a fresh POST /agent/chat.
expected: Plain phrasing, the same in every run: "New: laptop in Node 2 Harmony (NOD2) at 2026-10-18 03:19 UTC" and "Used: drill by person (grey t-shirt, dark shorts)…". It ends with "…and 50 more. See Overview" as a link.
actual: In the conversation: "new_item: laptop, Node 2 Harmony, 03:19 UTC" and "moved: person (actor: blue shirt, dark pants, black hair), USOS, 03:18 UTC". The fresh call returns prose instead ("person: new item observed at…"), so the format isn't deterministic. Answers write "03:19 UTC" with no date and bare codes (NOD2, USOS), while the citations and the app use "2026-10-18 03:19 UTC" and "Node 2 Harmony (NOD2)". "and 50 more" has no link.
suggested_fix: Render recent_changes answers with the deterministic template (as for grounded fallbacks), reusing the dashboard's event phrasing, the full timestamp and the location name. Add a link to /overview.

title: Merge, unmerge and history wording is inconsistent
steps: Merge 2348f197 into a26efebe, unmerge it from the item page, merge it again and use Undo in the toast. Then open both histories, and also /items/238ee99a-....
expected: One verb for the operation ("unmerge"), and every toast and banner names the item with its short id.
actual: The audit rows say "split by ui-review-3" while the UI says Unmerge. The item-page toast says "Unmerged: cargo transfer bag is a separate item again." (no id), but the toast Undo says "Merge undone: cargo transfer bag 2348f197 …". The banner "Merged into cargo transfer bag" has no id, which is ambiguous when both items have the same label. History mixes "2 × update by pipeline" with "2 pipeline updates (sighting refresh: last_seen_at/confidence)", and every sighting is paired with an "update by pipeline" audit row (m-bag e7c5d8d2: 19 sightings, 20 audit rows).
suggested_fix: Map the audit op split to "unmerge" in the history summary. Use the label plus short id in all toasts and in the banner. Fold sighting-refresh audit rows into the sighting they belong to.

title: axe page-has-heading-one on the not-found pages
expected: 0 violations. The not-found state renders an h1 ("Item not found" / "Page not found").
actual: There is 1 moderate page-has-heading-one violation on each page, at both widths. All other pages have 0 violations. The only console and network errors are the expected 404s for the missing id.
suggested_fix: Use an <h1> in NotFound and in the item-detail error state.
